summary: XTI Aerospace filed an 8-K furnishing preliminary unaudited results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 and disclosing completion of an internal review by an all-independent-director committee, represented by independent counsel, into matters concerning its former Chief Executive Officer who resigned August 17, 2026, plus related governance issues. The Committee found no financial misstatements and the Company expects to report second quarter results later in October 2026. No deal terms, stake, price, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock were stated. Watch for restated or delayed financials, governance remediation, and Nasdaq listing-compliance risk.
